name: causentra-workspace
description: Local-first production infrastructure for observable AI agents

scripts.build: npm run build -w @causentra/sdk && npm run build -w @causentra/openai-agents && npm run build -w @causentra/langgraph && npm run build -w @causentra/opentelemetry && npm run build -w @causentra/server && npm run build -w @causentra/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck -w @causentra/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @causentra/openai-agents && npm run typecheck -w @causentra/langgraph && npm run typecheck -w @causentra/opentelemetry && npm run typecheck -w @causentra/server && npm run typecheck -w @causentra/cli
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test -w @causentra/sdk && npm run test -w @causentra/openai-agents && npm run test -w @causentra/langgraph && npm run test -w @causentra/opentelemetry && npm run test -w @causentra/server && npm run test -w @causentra/cli && npm run python:test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:adapter-template
scripts.python:lint: python -m ruff check python/src python/tests python/scripts python/benchmarks
scripts.python:verify: npm run python:lint && npm run python:typecheck && npm run python:test && npm run python:build && npm run python:installcheck
scripts.verify: npm run verify:brand && npm run verify:community && npm run verify:discovery && npm run typecheck && npm run python:verify && npm test && npm run verify:packages && npm run verify:install
